name: Minimized
author: Jadon
description: Minimized windows on the bar, with a keyboard-driven list that restores each window to where it came from.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one list: every window tucked away on special:minimized. Restores its workspace, floating state, size, and position.

schema.label: Always show the icon
schema.description: Keep the bar icon visible when nothing is minimized. Turn off to have it appear only while a window is tucked away.
